title: Dolly product lexical replay: noninferiority against the frozen session-document BM25 reference
question: Dolly's product lexical retrieval treats memory as per-message Blocks, NFC-normalized all-unicode tokens, 512-byte segments with 64-byte overlap, and ranks records rather than sessions; the frozen v4 reference treats each session as one NFKC-normalized document ranked by content BM25. Is the product lexical representation close enough to the frozen session-document BM25 reference to justify installing durable-journal and Module wiring, without enabling automatic recall, automatic resume, vector/hybrid retrieval, association expansion, or checkpointing?

hypotheses.primary: On the 353 sealed evaluation questions, product NDCG@10 and Recall@10 are each no worse than the frozen content reference within a paired lower-95% margin of -0.02, and product knowledge-update top-one error is no more than 0.02 worse than reference.
hypotheses.decisionPositive: A pass freezes the current extractor, segment, rank, and duplicate semantics for the next reversible engineering slice (durable file journal, Block reader, restart/delete/isolation tests, explicit-query-only admission).
hypotheses.decisionNegative: A miss rejects production wiring for this representation; a later attempt may change one preregistered representation factor using development data and must receive a new version and sealed evaluation.

baselines.description: Frozen v4 session-document content BM25 top-10 ranking is the read-only reference and is not refit.

treatments.description: Dolly product Memory lexical path: one dolly.content/1 Block per session, one text item per message as lowercase role and exact content, NFC normalization, all-unicode tokens, 512-byte segments with 64-byte overlap, record-level ranking, then rank-to-session mapping without collapsing before the top-10 cutoff.

frozenParameters.duplicateRule: first returned occurrence gains one; later occurrences keep their original recorded rank and gain zero (never collapse-and-refill)

data.goldIsolation: Treatment reads only gold-blind cases.jsonl rows (question_id, question, sessions) and never answer_session_ids, answers, question type, split, dates, or reference rankings. A separate analyzer may read split/gold only after every treatment row is persisted and verified.

backend.process: one worker per case is gold-blind; the analyzer is a separate process and never imports treatment
backend.dependencies: node:fs, node:crypto, node:path only for the verifier; the treatment imports only the real product Memory modules

randomness.determinism: No model, network, provider, or sampling exists; all steps are deterministic and repeatable byte-for-byte.
randomness.streamSeparation: The shared 10,000-row evaluation resample matrix from retrieval-v4-20260813a is reused unchanged; no new bootstrap stream is generated.

metrics.knowledgeUpdate: top-one error using the existing six-type LongMemEval classification
metrics.duplicates: repeated returned occurrences occupy their original ranks with zero gain
metrics.cost: canonicalFeatureBytes / coveredNormalizedBytes with zero-denominator non-zero-numerator treated as infinity

execution.failurePolicy: Typed product limit/coverage/job failures are persisted as closed failure rows and force classification rejected, never inconclusive. Any structural, isolation, checksum, independent-verification, or mutation failure prevents supported/rejected classification.

decisionRules.classificationOrder: Validate checksum inventory, gold-blind projection, complete rankings, coverage and terminal-job gate, source hashes, independent recomputation, and mutation rejection before inspecting any efficacy or cost threshold.
supported: paired lower 95% bound of NDCG@10(product - reference) >= -0.02
paired lower 95% bound of Recall@10(product - reference) >= -0.02
every row passes coverage and terminal-job gate; p95 canonicalFeatureBytes/coveredNormalizedBytes <= 2
all 500 treatment rows, rank/record/Block/session mappings, checksums, source hashes, independent metric recomputation, and preregistered mutation tests validate
rejected: a structurally valid miss of any gate rejects production wiring for this representation
the evaluation split must not be inspected to tune representation factors
inconclusive: any earlier structural/checksum/verification/mutation failure prevents a supported or rejected classification
running the synthetic foundation bundle does not observe sealed evaluation outcomes

independentValidation.recomputeSurface: recompute coverage bytes, record/rank/session mapping, duplicate-rank occupancy, and canonical digest of every persisted row from frozen bytes; reuse the v4 resample matrix unchanged

domainDesign.extractor: createTextContentExtractor with NFC and whitespace normalization, maxInputBytes bound, typed skip reasons
domainDesign.segment: 512-byte segments, 64-byte overlap, per-message union coverage computed once
domainDesign.rank: lexical BM25 record ranking then rank-to-session mapping with sourceBlockId provenance
domainDesign.duplicate: keep every returned rank; first gold occurrence gains one, later occurrences gain zero and never consume a refilled position
domainDesign.modeQuery: exactly one explicit dolly.memory.query/1 mode:lexical with limit 10 and contextExpansion 0
